cohort: The study included 2966 pregnancies in women with structural heart disease enrolled from 99 hospitals.
finding: VTA occurred in 1.4% of pregnant women with cardiovascular disease, mainly in the third trimester, and was associated with heart failure during pregnancy and adverse fetal outcomes including neonatal death, preterm birth, low birthweight, and low Apgar score.
mod_finding: Women with VTA had a significantly higher rate of Cesarean section compared to women without VTA (68% vs. 47%).
